levels.surface: أبي محمد بن عمرو بن حريث

notes: جده, حريث is one link whose surface is the name alone (rule 7); the dash gloss رجل من بني عذرة is left out.
عن أبي القاسم is the Prophet, the end of the chain, not a link.
Sufyan's remarks and Ahmad's descriptions of the mark are not routes; the editor gloss يعني ابن المديني is left out, so the name stays علي.
